# ccusage-gauge

> macOS menu-bar app, dashboard, CLI, and local HTTP API that shows how much of your Claude Code and Codex (ChatGPT) subscription limits you have used: the 5-hour and weekly windows as used/remaining percentages with reset countdowns, extra-usage credits, and token/API-equivalent cost history aggregated by ccusage.

Key facts:

- Subscription limit usage (5-hour and weekly windows, used and remaining %, reset time) is read directly from each provider's own usage endpoint using the local Claude Code and Codex CLI logins. It is not estimated from token cost.
- Extended usage ("credit"): Claude extra-usage spend against its monthly limit, and Codex credit balance.
- Token counts and API-equivalent cost come from local Claude Code and Codex logs via ccusage (https://github.com/ryoppippi/ccusage), broken down by model, agent, machine, and directory; remote machines are supported over SSH for cost data.
- Menu bar: Claude and ChatGPT/Codex icons fill from bottom to top as usage rises; optional percentages; spend or budget progress; hover tooltip with credits.
- Platforms: menu-bar app on macOS (Apple silicon and Intel); CLI and dashboard server on macOS and Linux.
- Install: `brew install ccusage` then `brew install --cask tacogips/tap/ccusage-gauge`.
- Credentials are sent only to the provider's usage endpoint and are never logged, stored, or returned.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/tacogips/ccusage-gauge/blob/main/README.md): overview, FAQ, install, configuration
- [Subscription usage and display controls](https://github.com/tacogips/ccusage-gauge/blob/main/README.md#subscription-usage-and-display-controls): data sources, refresh and throttling behavior, menu-bar and dashboard options, `GET /api/rate-limits` example
- [Remote machines](https://github.com/tacogips/ccusage-gauge/blob/main/README.md#remote-machines): SSH collection of cost data
- [Dashboard client commands](https://github.com/tacogips/ccusage-gauge/blob/main/README.md#dashboard-client-commands): CLI access to metrics
